description: Job Toast helps a signed-in user track a job search from ChatGPT. It can show the user's work profile, list, filter and open saved jobs, save a new job (optionally with a salary range, work type and the date the user already applied), change a job's status or interview date and add a dated note, mark a job applied after the user submits it, save and read back the questions and answers from an application, and draft a cover letter. It does not search the open job market, it does not delete jobs, and it does not submit applications on employer sites.

defaultPrompt: What jobs am I tracking, and which ones are at the interview stage?
Log a job I just applied to, with the salary range and whether it's remote.
Draft a cover letter for one of my saved jobs.
